config.label: Sonenta API key (mcp:* scope)
config.description: Sonenta API key (mcp:* scope). If omitted, the server reads it from ~/.sonenta/credentials (run `sonenta login`). Legacy SONENTA_TOKEN / VERBUMIA_API_KEY / VERBUMIA_TOKEN are also accepted.

config.label: Comma-separated project UUIDs to scope the server to
config.description: Comma-separated project UUIDs to scope the server to. Optional; use SONENTA_PROJECT for a single project.

config.label: Optional agent identity — a short run name that groups this session's work in the Sonenta dashboard
config.description: Optional agent identity — a short run name that groups this session's work in the Sonenta dashboard.

config.description: Optional agent identity — the agent kind (e.g. sonenta-i18n, sonenta-a11y).

config.description: Optional agent identity — the agent version. Defaults to the server's own version when unset.
